'''King Aurelius III''' was a western ruler associated in source material with the early standardization of the [[Vesperan Alphabet]] around 1350.

The main source-backed fact about Aurelius is his connection to the [[Royal Scriptorial Decree]], which later Vesperan scholarship treated as an early foundation for written Vesperan.

== Canon Note ==

This is a minimal bridge page. Aurelius's reign dates, dynasty, capital, and relationship to the later [[House of Vespera]] are not yet established and should not be filled in without a broader early Vesperan history pass.
